skill-md.why: Contract src/contracts/invoice_paid.py lists event_id, invoice_id, invoice_version, order_id, paid_on. These are ids, the paid date shipping asked for, and the dedupe and ordering keys that rules 4 and 5 need. No amount, customer or invoice state is carried, and the docstring says no state transfer is declared. The relay builds the body through invoice_paid.build, which copies named fields only (invoice_id, order_id, paid_on from the outbox payload), so nothing extra leaks even though the outbox payload is the whole internal event.
